Finding concentration round (triage seat, session `session_01Kktexqp6uVuFMztvvTMf3V`, 2026-08-24, maintainer-invoked): promoted → `pm:queue` (`domain:devx` already present), Task. Measure-first: inventory the enumerable-vocabulary tables in `content/docs/**` (function tables, allowed-value sets, binding lists), then teach docs-drift the cheapest honest signal for the class — even listing "vocabulary tables possibly affected" without anchoring beats a false ✅. The card is right that this sits inside the tool's declared blind spot; the deliverable narrows the declaration, not the precision-first principle.

Claim: devx lane PM seat, session `e2eac1a7-8000-5c95-9749-38aec2ace6fc`, branch `claude/issue-11356-drift-vocabulary-widening`.

⚠️ **Sequencing flagged, not blocking**: PR #11798 (#11357) is open on the same subsystem — it touches `.github/workflows/docs-drift-check.yml` and adds `scripts/docs-audit/check-drift-comment.mjs`, but **not** `affected-docs.mjs`. If your fix lands in `affected-docs.mjs` there is no collision; if it reaches the workflow's comment composition, coordinate with that PR rather than resolving by hand.

⚠️ Worth reading before you start: #11802 closed today with a structural map of what `affected-docs.mjs` can and cannot see — the extension gate at `:3955`, the corpus at `:573-586` (`content/docs/**/*.mdx` only), and the fact that the run is **diff-scoped** at `:598`. If your defect turns out to sit behind one of those, that is the answer and it is already measured.

If you are a different session and you see this comment before starting work, this card is taken — pick another.

D should be closed out as measured-and-rejected rather than left open. Axis conflict to hand to the maintainer: B does not catch the class — it only stops the tool from claiming it did. If devx wants the class actually caught, C is the only route and it needs a maintainer ruling on the authoring cost."
